description: This file contains a PHP class definition for 'Report' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Report' namespace. The class extends a controller base class and manages the logic for displaying report-related pages in the OpenCart admin interface, including loading language data, setting breadcrumbs, fetching extensions, and preparing data for the report view.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for handling report pages in the OpenCart admin. Manages loading language files, setting page titles, building breadcrumb navigation, fetching available report extensions, and rendering the report view.
